name: Hody Jones
title: Attack with a vengeance at the cost of your Life!
desc:
Activate powerful effects by adding New Fish-Man Pirates type Characters to your hand at the cost of your Life.

While you will need to withstand your Life cards being drained by your Leader's effect, this monochromatic green deck boasts surprising deployment and offensive power.

cards.name: Hody Jones
cards.text: [Activate: Main] You may rest this Leader: Rest up to 1 of your opponent's DON!! cards or Characters with a cost of 3 or less. Then, you cannot add Life cards to your hand using your own effects during this turn.

cards.name: Camie
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 4 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Fish-Man} or {Merfolk} type card other than [Camie] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Zeo
cards.text: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] If your Leader has the {New Fish-Man Pirates} type, set up to 1 of your DON!! cards as active and this Character gains +1000 power during this turn. Then, add 1 card from the top of your Life cards to your hand.

cards.name: Hammond
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

cards.name: Vander Decken IX
cards.text: [On Play] You may trash 1 {Fish-Man} type card from your hand or 1 [The Ark Noah] from your hand or field: K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's rested Characters.

cards.name: Daruma
cards.text: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If your Leader has the {New Fish-Man Pirates} type, set this Character as active and this Character gains +1000 power during this turn. Then, add 1 card from the top of your Life cards to your hand.

cards.name: Dosun
cards.text: [When Attacking] If your Leader has the {New Fish-Man Pirates} type, this Character cannot be K.O.'d in battle and gains +2000 power until the start of your next turn. Then, add 1 card from the top of your Life cards to your hand.

cards.name: Dracule Mihawk
cards.types: The Seven Warlords of the Sea/Muggy Kingdom
cards.text: [On Play] If you have 2 or less Characters, play up to 1 {Muggy Kingdom} type or <Slash> attribute Character card with a cost of 4 or less other than [Dracule Mihawk] from your hand rested.

cards.name: Arlong
cards.text: [On Play] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Up to 1 of your opponent's rested Leader cannot attack until the end of your opponent's next turn.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.

cards.name: Hatchan
cards.trigger: [Trigger] Play up to 1 {Fish-Man} or {Merfolk} type Character card with a cost of 3 or less from your hand.

cards.name: Ikaros Much
cards.text: [On Play] If your Leader has the {New Fish-Man Pirates} type, play up to 1 {Fish-Man} type Character card with a cost of 4 or less from your hand. Then, add 1 card from the top of your Life cards to your hand.

cards.name: Hody Jones
cards.text:
[Rush] (This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)
[On Play] Rest up to a total of 2 of your opponent's Characters or DON!! cards. Then, add 1 card from the top of your Life cards to your hand.

cards.name: The Billion-fold World Trichiliocosm
cards.text: [Counter] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +2000 power during this battle. Then, if you have 8 or more rested cards, that card gains an additional +2000 power during this battle.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's rested Characters with a cost of 3 or less.
